title: Hearing on the future of the city's cultural plan CreateNYC
summary: The Council's Cultural Affairs Committee will examine progress on CreateNYC, the city's cultural plan established by a 2015 law, and what comes next for it. It will review the Department of Cultural Affairs' tracking of goals and funding since 2017 and question how a new racial equity plan will affect future updates. The committee will also hear several unrelated ceremonial resolutions at the same hearing.
